newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila gets Asian Development Bank $274 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Manila gets Asian Development Bank $274 mln loan.

text.p: The Philippines Department of Finance said on Monday it signed $274 million worth of loan agreements with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to finance three infrastructure projects.
Some $167 million would be used by the Department of Public Works and Highways to maintain and repair national roads and repair and replace bridges.
Another $37 million loan package would be used for a rural water supply and a sanitation project.
The ADB would also finance a third project that would involve development of infrastructure and improvement of social services at the northern province of Bukidnon.
The finance department said a guarantee agreement was also signed with the ADB for a $50 million loan by the Local Water Utilities Administration for its small towns water supply project.
